annotations.title: Verify NY LLC Publication Ad Compliance

description: Checks a publication notice the person already has against the items the statute lists (Section 206(a), 802(b) or 1203, by entity type). Automated checks look for the LLC's name, the Secretary of State designation, the address the Secretary of State mails process to, the county, the filing date, and Notice of Qualification wording for a foreign LLC; when one is missing or does not match it reports NOT COMPLIANT with the specific items and, where it can, a suggested corrected notice (it fills in only the mailing address, with bracketed placeholders, and for a foreign LLC the notice type and the New York filing reference). Every answer also lists each item the statute names, to check against the notice. Works for domestic LLCs, foreign LLCs and PLLCs. An automated check, not legal advice. Do NOT use to draft a notice (use llc_publication_generate_ad_text), for prices (use llc_publication_get_county_pricing), or for requirements (use llc_publication_check_requirements).
